name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
steps: Kneel beside a bench and rest your forearms palms down on the pad with your hands holding the bar just beyond its edge.
Lift your knuckles by bending your wrists back.
Lower the bar slowly while your forearms remain on the bench.
tips: Keep your fingers closed firmly around the bar and forearms flat on the bench.
Use a light barbell and move slowly without jerking your wrists upward.
